query: Write a story: ingest delegated roster.
expected_behavior: Classifies volume as file-scale (20,000 rows) and applies the volume rule
Compares at least the shipped roster capability (rung 0 with Data 360), bulk Apex (rung 5) and middleware (rung 6), and records the rejected options with reasons
States a governor and volume strategy: chunking, idempotency, partial-success handling and retry
Includes exception handling for rows that fail validation and a review route for them
Lists the directory and claims as downstream consumers with impact (A-5)
Uses the Roster Analyst persona or the adapter-mapped title
must_not: Propose a record-by-record Flow or OmniScript chain for the file
Assume an in-org async framework that discovery did not find
Omit what happens to partially loaded files
